2. Declared three stopping rules upfront (best_so_far_above 1.0, failures_at_least 2, last_gain_at_most 0.02 — all set to *stop*, favoring discipline over continued mining).

6. Honored that trigger rather than switching rules to keep searching, and stopped.

**Candidate submitted:** rule **[32+, 35-]**, in-sample Sharpe 0.483 (all-years) / 0.546 (recent-weighted) — well above the baseline model.

**Caveat that shaped my prediction:** the gate's 90% lower bound came back at **-0.633**, signaling that this short, greedy 2-feature search carries real overfitting risk and the in-sample edge may not generalize. I therefore predicted an out-of-sample Sharpe of **mean 0.15, sd 0.40** — meaningfully shrunk from the in-sample 0.48, roughly in line with (or only modestly above) the baseline's realized Sharpe, reflecting that most of the in-sample outperformance is likely selection effect rather than durable signal.
